## Lifecycle

- [ ] This PR targets the current base branch.
- [ ] The current head SHA is the SHA that was verified.
- [ ] A closed, unmerged PR is not considered complete; reopen it or create a replacement PR.
- [ ] The linked Issue is closed only after this PR is merged.
